feeding_claim.verbatim: Our 100% grass fed cows graze on native grasses deep in the Owyhee Mountain Range for eight months out of the year.

farmers_markets: Capital City Public Market, The Grove Plaza, Boise (April through December)
notes: Ranch in the Owyhee Mountains southwest of Boise, found in the Idaho Beef Council producer directory and confirmed on the ranch's own site. Orders go through a Barn2Door store. The contact page says the ranch delivers and ships to the Lower 48 and sells at the Capital City Public Market in Boise from April through December, but it does not name a local delivery area, so none was recorded. The site calls the beef USDA Certified Grass-Fed; the USDA grass-fed program list could not be opened during this check, so no certification was added. The site says cattle graze native range eight months a year and does not say what they eat the rest of the year, so the category was kept at grass-fed rather than grass-finished. The FAQ and shipping page and the about page would not load. No phone number and no quarter or half beef found.
